forecast_method: No-change/null prior: because no permitted target labels or local holdout distinguishes these new Track A variants, carry forward the documented historical public RMSE of the all-zero C0 baseline as the prior expected public RMSE for each candidate. The value is not fit to candidate outputs or a claim of candidate accuracy. Freeze this value and its basis before any candidate is scored.

prior_source.use: Prior only; not a model parameter, candidate-selection score, or newly accessed leaderboard value.

limitations: This null prior makes no candidate-specific performance claim and cannot establish an improvement over P4.
The forecast is not a measured local held-out score and therefore does not meet the general calibration-purpose local-holdout gate by itself.
Adoption requires explicit operator approval of both the forecast prior and any exception to the local-heldout requirement. Without that approval, do not register or upload candidates on this basis.
unblock_request: Approve or reject this explicit null-prior forecast for calibration, and state whether its use is permitted despite the no-label local-heldout limitation.
